title: Wake persistence after idle carried-launcher retirement removes a restart marker
outcome: Retirement from the test-run tick promptly schedules persistence of removed launcher restart markers, without waiting for unrelated activity.
acceptance: When poll_engram_carried_runs retires at least one carry, schedule the existing Delta persistence path after releasing the state lock.

A behavioral regression observes the production persistence wake/write for an otherwise idle session; stamp selection and manually invoking persistence alone are insufficient. Retained run reservation and honest restart disclosure remain unchanged.
